**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate CURRENT proof status against PR head SHA**

In `_proof_is_current`, the `CURRENT` branch trusts `proof_freshness.matches_pr_head` and never verifies that `proof_head_sha` actually equals the current `pr_head_sha`. Because `proof_freshness` comes from proof payload data, a stale proof can be marked `CURRENT` (with `matches_pr_head: true`) and pass readiness even when `proof.matches_pr_head` is false, which drops the `PROOF_STALE_OR_MISSING` blocker and can incorrectly return `READY`.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The `CURRENT` branch trusts the embedded `proof_freshness.matches_pr_head` value without re-checking `proof_head_sha` against the live PR head. A stale proof file can set `proof_freshness.status` to `CURRENT` and `matches_pr_head` to true, causing `_proof_is_current` to return true even when the collector's top-level `matches_pr_head` is false. Recompute the equality against `pr_head_sha` in this branch instead of trusting the proof-provided freshness flag.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The READY schema permits a self-reference exception solely from `proof_freshness.status`, so an artifact with `matches_pr_head: false`, `status: CURRENT_WITH_SELF_REFERENCE_EXCEPTION`, and a missing/null `self_reference_exception` still validates. The runtime requires supervisor acceptance plus proof-only changed-file evidence, so the schema should require and constrain those fields for this READY path to match the documented fail-closed semantics.

comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Honor outdated thread state in the thread classifier**

When GitHub returns a review thread with `isOutdated=true` but `isResolved=false`, this new branch marks the raw review comment as nonblocking, but `_classify_threads` still checks `not is_resolved` before `is_outdated` and adds `UNRESOLVED_REVIEW_THREAD`, so the PR remains `NEEDS_IMPLEMENTER`. That contradicts the newly documented acceptance rule that resolved or outdated threads must not remain active blockers, and makes the added outdated-comment handling ineffective for that common stale-thread state.
